changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'reporting' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Global_Audit') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [reporting].[Global_Audit]( [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) not null, [Object] [varchar](50) not null, [ObjectID] [int] not null, [ObjectName] [nvarchar](250) not null, [ResourceID] [int] not null, [Date] [datetime] not null, [Version] int constraint [DF_ReportingGlobalAudit_Version] default(1) not null, [Action] [varchar](15) not null, [ActionObject] [varchar](50) not null, [ActionObjectID] [int] not null, [ActionObjectTypeName] [nvarchar](250) not null, [ActionObjectName] [nvarchar](250) not null, [ActionDescription] [nvarchar](max) not null, constraint [PK_ReportingAudit] primary key nonclustered ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ReportingAudit_Object_ActionObject') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ReportingAudit_Object_ActionObject] ON [reporting].[Global_Audit] ( [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC, [ActionObject] ASC, [ActionObjectID] ASC ) END
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'reporting' and TABLE_NAME = 'Global_Audit' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Version') begin alter table reporting.Global_Audit add [Version] int constraint [DF_ReportingGlobalAudit_Version] default(1) not null; end GO
if not exists (select 1 from [sys].[default_constraints] where name = 'DF_ReportingGlobalAudit_Version') begin alter table reporting.Global_Audit add constraint [DF_ReportingGlobalAudit_Version] default(1) for [Version] end GO
if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'reporting' and TABLE_NAME = 'Global_Audit' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Version') begin alter table reporting.Global_Audit alter column [Version] int not null; end
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ReportingAudit_ActionObject_ActionObjectID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ReportingAudit_ActionObject_ActionObjectID] ON [reporting].[Global_Audit] ([ActionObject],[ActionObjectID]) END

IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ReportingAudit_Object_ActionObject_Include') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ReportingAudit_Object_ActionObject_Include] ON [reporting].[Global_Audit] ( [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC, [ActionObject] ASC, [ActionObjectID] ASC ) INCLUDE([Version],[ID]) END
